<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/custom-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BuildCustomMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Building" name="Start building custom machine"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSets" name="Give sets to children"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_BuildTestComponents" name="Build and test each subcomponent">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Component" name="Start subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialParts" name="Parts remain in relevant container?" default="Flow_InitialPartsUnavailable"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderInitialParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialPartsMerge" name="Continue to build"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildComponent" name="Build subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TestComponent" name="Test subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Test successful?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignComponent" name="Redesign subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RebuildParts" name="Parts remain in relevant container?" default="Flow_RebuildPartsUnavailable"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderRebuildParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RebuildPartsMerge" name="Continue to rebuild"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RebuildComponent" name="Rebuild subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Component" name="Subcomponent test successful"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComponentStartToParts" sourceRef="StartEvent_Component" targetRef="Gateway_InitialParts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialPartsAvailable" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialParts" targetRef="Gateway_InitialPartsMerge">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">parts remain in the relevant container</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialPartsUnavailable" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialParts" targetRef="Task_ReorderInitialParts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialReorderToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderInitialParts" targetRef="Gateway_InitialPartsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialMergeToBuild" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialPartsMerge" targetRef="Task_BuildComponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToTest" sourceRef="Task_BuildComponent" targetRef="Task_TestComponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestToResult" sourceRef="Task_TestComponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestSuccessful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="EndEvent_Component">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">test is successful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestUnsuccessful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RedesignComponent">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">test is unsuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RedesignToParts" sourceRef="Task_RedesignComponent" targetRef="Gateway_RebuildParts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RebuildPartsAvailable" sourceRef="Gateway_RebuildParts" targetRef="Gateway_RebuildPartsMerge">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">parts remain in the relevant container</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RebuildPartsUnavailable" sourceRef="Gateway_RebuildParts" targetRef="Task_ReorderRebuildParts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RebuildReorderToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderRebuildParts" targetRef="Gateway_RebuildPartsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RebuildMergeToRebuild" sourceRef="Gateway_RebuildPartsMerge" targetRef="Task_RebuildComponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RebuildToTest" sourceRef="Task_RebuildComponent" targetRef="Task_TestComponent"/>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="true"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleComponents" name="Assemble subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineBuilt" name="Custom machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDesign" sourceRef="StartEvent_Building" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignToOrder" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToGive" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiveToSort" sourceRef="Task_GiveSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SortToComponents" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="SubProcess_BuildTestComponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComponentsToAssembly" sourceRef="SubProcess_BuildTestComponents" targetRef="Task_AssembleComponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssemblyToEnd" sourceRef="Task_AssembleComponents" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineBuilt"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
